sloka: याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा ते ऽहमिति प्रभो ।तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता ।। ७.२६.५१ ॥
transliteration: yācyamāno mayā deva snuṣā te 'hamiti prabho ।tatsarvaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā balāttenāsmi dharṣitā ।। 7.26.51 ॥

translations.english: O god, O lord, despite being implored by me that I am your daughter-in-law, he disregarded all that and forcibly violated me.
